title: allow copy paste in password fields
name: Allow copy and paste in password fields — GOV.UK
rule: Always allow users to copy and paste in password fields.
pass_when: Paste (and copy when shown) works in the password field.
fail_when: The password field blocks paste or otherwise prevents copying from a password manager.
overview: Let people paste into password fields, including from a password manager.
not_when: Not a requirement to copy hidden (type=password) text; browsers only copy when the field is shown.
agent_hint: Do not disable paste on password inputs.
description: Always allow users to copy and paste in password fields. People may have good reasons, including using a password manager. Pass when paste works; fail when the field blocks paste or prevents copying from a manager. Copying hidden password text is browser behaviour when the field is shown and is not something to override. This is paste permission, not autocomplete token choice.
do_not_claim: Generic form autocomplete (`forms.inputs.html_autocomplete_and_name`); `new-password` vs `current-password` tokens. maxlength / character-set restrictions on passwords.
